statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope
These symptoms are inconsistent with the patient's known sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The service is to evaluate for unspecified arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
